# Nexbeck - Complete Business Information

> A comprehensive guide to Nexbeck, its company,
> services, pricing, target audience and business information.

# 1. Company Information

## About Nexbeck

Nexbeck is a specialised web design and development agency engineered specifically for Australian electricians, electrical contractors, and trade businesses. Operating remotely from Pakistan, Nexbeck designs, builds, and launches high-converting, mobile-optimised websites for clients across all Australian states and territories.

Nexbeck was created to counter common trade agency practices: bloated WordPress themes that take 6+ seconds to load, generic templates, lack of transparent pricing, high monthly lock-in retainers, and agencies withholding code ownership. Nexbeck operates on fixed Australian Dollar pricing (including GST), milestone-based payments, 7 to 18-day delivery timelines, and guaranteed 100% code and domain ownership upon project completion.

## Mission

Nexbeck's mission is to provide Australian electrical contractors with fast, practical, and credible websites that turn local search visitors into qualified phone calls and quote requests—without recurring agency retainers, hidden fees, or technical complexity.

## Target Audience

Nexbeck works exclusively with trade contractors in the Australian market, including:
- Independent residential electricians and solo contractors looking for a credible online presence.
- Established electrical contracting businesses seeking local suburban search visibility and higher conversion rates.
- Commercial electrical contractors and multi-van electrical teams requiring authority positioning and interactive quote tools.
- Air conditioning (HVAC) and trade contractors offering complementary electrical services.

## Service Area

Nexbeck serves trade businesses Australia-wide, covering every state and territory:
- New South Wales (NSW) — Sydney, Newcastle, Wollongong, Central Coast, and regional NSW
- Victoria (VIC) — Melbourne, Geelong, Ballarat, Bendigo, and regional Victoria
- Queensland (QLD) — Brisbane, Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, Townsville, Cairns, and regional QLD
- Western Australia (WA) — Perth, Mandurah, Bunbury, and regional WA
- South Australia (SA) — Adelaide and regional South Australia
- Tasmania (TAS) — Hobart, Launceston, and regional Tasmania
- Australian Capital Territory (ACT) — Canberra and surrounding districts
- Northern Territory (NT) — Darwin, Alice Springs, and regional NT

# 2. What Nexbeck Does

Nexbeck solves the primary technical and commercial challenges trade contractors face online:

1. **Slow Mobile Performance**: Most trade websites built with WordPress or page builders load slowly on mobile networks. Nexbeck builds lightweight, static HTML5/CSS/JavaScript websites deployed on Cloudflare edge servers, delivering sub-second load times on smartphones.
2. **Missing Trade Credibility**: Homeowners and builders look for contractor licence numbers, ABN verification, insurance claims, and real customer reviews. Nexbeck integrates these trust markers prominently on every page.
3. **Low Conversion Rates**: Nexbeck designs websites with thumb-friendly click-to-call buttons, clear service offerings, emergency callout highlights, and frictionless enquiry forms.
4. **Predatory Agency Retainers**: Many agencies charge $300 to $800 AUD per month in ongoing fees while locking clients into proprietary platforms. Nexbeck charges fixed one-time build fees with zero mandatory ongoing retainers.
5. **Ownership Restrictions**: Nexbeck transfers 100% ownership of all source code, design files, and domain registrations to the client upon final payment.

# 3. Services

## Service 1: Custom Electrician Website Design

### Description
End-to-end custom website design and frontend development engineered specifically for Australian electricians. Hand-coded for maximum speed, clean search engine crawlability, and optimal mobile experience.

### Features
- Mobile-first responsive layout optimised for trade customers browsing on smartphones
- Instant click-to-call phone buttons and quick enquiry forms
- Electrical contractor licence number and ABN compliance display
- Suburban service area landing sections targeting local search intent
- Google Reviews and verified customer testimonial integration
- Past work and completed project showcase
- Web3Forms secure form submission handling (30-day enquiry retention)
- Baseline on-page SEO, OpenGraph social cards, and Schema.org structured data
- Cloudflare CDN edge deployment with SSL/TLS encryption

### Benefits
- Turns search traffic into phone calls and quote submissions
- Establishes immediate trust and legitimacy against competitors
- Operates with zero database maintenance and zero WordPress plugin vulnerabilities

## Service 2: Website Redesign

### Description
Complete structural, visual, and performance overhaul of outdated, slow, or non-converting electrical contractor websites.

### Features
- Modern, clean layout aligned with trade customer expectations
- Complete migration of existing content, photos, and branding
- 301 redirect mapping to protect and preserve existing search engine ranking authority
- Performance optimisation replacing heavy builders with lightweight code
- Upgraded conversion pathways with prominent call-to-actions

### Benefits
- Eliminates sluggish mobile load times and lowers bounce rates
- Modernises business image when prospective clients research the contractor online
- Improves local search visibility and lead generation

## Service 3: Free Website Audit

### Description
A comprehensive, zero-obligation technical and visual review of an electrician's current website. Delivered within 48 hours in plain English.

### Features
- Mobile responsiveness and real-world loading speed analysis
- Local SEO schema and search crawlability evaluation
- Conversion bottleneck and contact clarity assessment
- Plain-English report with actionable recommendations

### Benefits
- Provides clear insight into why an existing website may not be generating enquiries
- 100% free with no sales calls or obligation to hire Nexbeck

# 4. Pricing and Packages

## Package 1: Essential Package

- Price: $890 AUD (Under $1,000 AUD, includes GST)
- Best for: Solo electricians, sole traders, or apprentices launching their independent contracting business who need a professional, trustworthy online presence.
- What's included:
  - 3 custom pages: Home, Services, Contact
  - Mobile-first responsive design
  - Prominent click-to-call telephone buttons
  - Trade licence number and ABN integration
  - Google Reviews showcase
  - Web3Forms contact form
  - Fast Cloudflare SSL setup
  - On-page SEO metadata and Schema.org markup
  - 1 structured round of revisions
  - 7-calendar-day delivery
  - 30-day post-launch warranty support
- Exclusions: Suburban area landing pages, interactive cost calculator, multi-van team features.

## Package 2: Professional Package

- Price: $1,390 AUD ($1,000–$1,500 AUD, includes GST)
- Best for: Established electrical businesses seeking to capture local suburban market share, rank for specific services, and steadily increase inbound enquiries.
- What's included:
  - 5 custom pages: Home, Services, About, Projects/Gallery, Contact
  - Suburban service area landing sections
  - Interactive before-and-after project gallery
  - Trade review and accreditation badge display
  - Advanced Schema.org electrical trade structured data
  - 3 structured rounds of revisions
  - 7 to 14-calendar-day delivery
  - 30-day post-launch warranty support
- Exclusions: Custom interactive price calculator / estimator tool.

## Package 3: Premium Package

- Price: $1,990 AUD ($1,500–$2,300 AUD, includes GST)
- Best for: Multi-van electrical contractors, commercial electricians, or contractors wanting advanced quote tools and market dominance.
- What's included:
  - Multi-page authority architecture
  - Interactive electrical cost calculator / quote estimator
  - Emergency callout banner with priority phone routing
  - Multi-suburb geographical coverage sections
  - Complete Schema.org service catalog structured data
  - 5 structured rounds of revisions
  - 14 to 18-calendar-day delivery
  - 30-day post-launch warranty support

## Additional Costs

- Domain: Free setup if the client already owns a domain. If registered via Nexbeck, the client is registered as the sole legal registrant.
- Hosting: Optional managed domain + high-performance Cloudflare edge hosting add-on available for $149 AUD per year. Setup is 100% free if the client provides their own hosting.
- Maintenance: Zero mandatory ongoing retainers. 30 days of post-launch bug fixing and support are included free with every build. Future updates are quoted at transparent, fixed prices.
- Additional features: Quoted separately before work commences (e.g. custom booking integrations, additional pages).

## Pricing Conditions

- Currency: Australian Dollars (AUD). All quoted prices include GST.
- Payment terms: 3 clear milestone payments:
  - Milestone 1: 30% after project brief, site plan, and wireframe are agreed upon.
  - Milestone 2: 30% upon completion of frontend design and interactive pages on private staging.
  - Milestone 3: 40% when the site is fully approved and ready to go live.
- One-time or recurring: One-time build cost. No recurring agency retainers or platform fees.
- Custom quotations: Provided in writing with deliverables, fixed prices, and estimated delivery dates.

# 5. Website Development Process

## Step 1: Discovery
Nexbeck gathers business details via a concise 15-minute onboarding brief: trade licence numbers, core electrical services, target suburbs, phone number, logos, and past project photos.

## Step 2: Design
Nexbeck creates a clear layout structure and wireframe tailored for Australian trade customers. Once the plan and deliverables are agreed upon, the initial 30% milestone is processed.

## Step 3: Development
Nexbeck hand-codes the website using clean, semantic static code. Copywriting, service descriptions, licence numbers, and contact forms are integrated and deployed to a private staging environment (30% milestone).

## Step 4: Testing
The client reviews the staging site on mobile and desktop. The client submits a consolidated list of requested text, image, or styling adjustments during their included revision rounds.

## Step 5: Delivery
Upon final approval and completion of the final 40% milestone, Nexbeck connects the client's custom domain, provisions Cloudflare CDN edge hosting, verifies Google Analytics 4 and Search Console, and hands over 100% of the code and assets.

# 6. Technology and Tools

- Frontend: Semantic HTML5, Modular Modern CSS (custom design system, zero bloated CSS frameworks), Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), Inline Vector SVG icons.
- Backend: Serverless form processing via Web3Forms (no server infrastructure needed, zero data selling, 30-day form message retention).
- Hosting: Cloudflare Pages / Cloudflare global edge network with free automatic SSL/TLS encryption, HTTP/3, and DDoS protection.
- CMS: Pure static site architecture. Eliminates slow database lookups, security vulnerabilities, and theme update breaks.

# 7. Frequently Asked Questions

## Who does Nexbeck work with?
Nexbeck works exclusively with Australian electricians, electrical contractors, air conditioning technicians, and trade businesses across all Australian states and territories.

## What services does Nexbeck provide?
Nexbeck provides custom website design, complete website redesigns, free website performance audits, and an optional managed domain and edge hosting add-on ($149 AUD/year).

## How much does a website cost?
Nexbeck offers three fixed-price packages: Essential ($890 AUD), Professional ($1,390 AUD), and Premium ($1,990 AUD). All prices include GST with zero hidden fees.

## How long does a website take to build?
Turnaround times range from 7 to 18 calendar days: Essential (7 days), Professional (7–14 days), and Premium (14–18 days). Timelines begin once the project brief and initial payment are received.

## Does Nexbeck provide website maintenance?
Nexbeck does not require or push recurring monthly agency retainers. Every package includes 30 days of post-launch warranty support. Future updates are quoted at transparent, one-off fixed rates.

# 8. Company Policies

## Revisions
Every package includes structured revision rounds: Essential (1 round), Professional (3 rounds), and Premium (5 rounds). Revisions cover text adjustments, image swaps, layout tweaks, and styling refinements.

## Refunds
If a client cancels before any wireframing or design work begins, a full 100% refund of the initial milestone payment is provided. If a project is cancelled during development, the client only pays for milestones completed to date and receives all completed source files.

## Ownership
The client owns 100% of all website code, design assets, and content upon final payment. The client is the sole legal registrant of any domain registered. Nexbeck retains no proprietary lock-in.
